```ts
import { env } from "zttp:env";
import { parallel } from "zttp:io";

export function handler(req: Request): Response {
    const [appName, apiSecret] = parallel([
        () => env("APP_NAME"),
        () => env("API_SECRET"),
    ]);
    if (apiSecret === undefined) {
        return Response.json({ error: "API_SECRET not set" }, { status: 503 });
    }
    return Response.json({ appName: appName ?? "unknown" });
}
```
